description: Submit an anonymized IOC/TTP sighting observed in the caller's own OT environment. Feeds the correlation corpus without storing an org identifier. Written to a separate sightings store, not intel.db. Price: $0.05 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired challenge; retry the identical call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].

actor_name.description: Optional actor name if the sighting is attributed

ioc_or_ttp_id.description: CVE ID, MITRE ATT&CK-for-ICS technique ID, or sha256 hash

region.description: Region where this was observed e.g. KSA, UAE

sector.description: Sector where this was observed e.g. energy, water

name: submitSighting
title: Submit OT Sighting
